# Rukun Al Arooba Used Furniture

> Rukun Al Arooba is a registered used furniture store located on Al Estiqlal Street, Bu Shaghara, Hay Al Qasimiah, Sharjah, UAE. Established in 2018 with over 20 years of industry experience, we buy and sell quality second-hand home furniture, office furniture, beds, sofas, home appliances, electronics, and refrigerators across the UAE. We serve Sharjah, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ajman, Al Ain, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain, and Fujairah with same-day service in Sharjah and a 5–10 minute response guarantee via WhatsApp.

Rukun Al Arooba is one of the most established used furniture dealers in the UAE. Our physical showroom is open 7 days a week for walk-in customers to browse, inspect, and purchase pre-owned furniture. We are officially registered with the Sharjah government (Trade License since 2018).

Key facts about Rukun Al Arooba:

- **Business type**: Used furniture store, furniture store, used appliance store, used office furniture store
- **Location**: Al Estiqlal Street, Bu Shaghara, Hay Al Qasimiah, Sharjah, UAE
- **Coordinates**: 25.342149799999998, 55.3955491
- **Phone**: +971 55 646 1731
- **Email**: rukun.al.arooba@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://rukunalaroobausedfurniture.ae/
- **Google rating**: 4.5 stars (19 reviews)
- **Operating hours**: Open daily 9 AM–11 PM (Wednesday closes at 10:30 PM, Monday closes at 11:30 PM)
- **Languages spoken**: Arabic, English, Hindi, Urdu
- **Price range**: Affordable / mid-range ($$)

What we do:

- **Buy used furniture**: We purchase second-hand furniture from individuals, families relocating, and businesses closing or upgrading — in any condition (scratched, faded, wobbly, or outdated). Instant cash payment upon collection.
- **Sell used furniture**: Our showroom offers a curated selection of quality pre-owned furniture pieces including sofas, beds, dining sets, wardrobes, desks, office chairs, refrigerators, washing machines, and more — all professionally inspected and many refurbished.
- **Professional restoration**: Our in-house workshop restores and refurbishes furniture to near-original quality before resale.
- **Delivery & pickup**: Same-day pickup in Sharjah. Delivery across all 7 Emirates via our partnership with Abu Muhammad Movers.
- **Office clearances**: Bulk commercial furniture buying for office relocations, closures, and upgrades — completed in one day with immediate payment.

Service options: Delivery, in-store pick-up, in-store shopping, on-site services, same-day delivery.

Offerings: Buys used goods, installation services, repair services, used goods.

Payments accepted: Cash, bank cheques, credit cards, NFC mobile payments, online bank transfers.

Warranty: 30-day warranty on all purchased furniture. 7-day return policy if expectations are not met.

Response time: Guaranteed response within 5–10 minutes via WhatsApp during business hours.
